coordinator.description: Team orchestrator. Analyzes requirements, assigns subtasks to specialists, and synthesizes their output into a cohesive solution.

product-owner.description: Defines scope, breaks features into user stories with acceptance criteria, and prioritizes the backlog.

business-analyst.description: Deep-dives into requirements, maps data flows, identifies edge cases, and produces structured analysis artifacts.

sde.description: Senior SDE. Implements features and bug fixes as clean, tested async Python code following AGENTS.md conventions.

qa.description: QA engineer. Owns test strategy, writes and runs pytest async tests, and gates quality before merge.

devops.description: Senior DevOps/SRE. Manages infrastructure, Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, database migrations, and production deployments.
